evidence.text:
Sparse graphs are empty. The two newest episodes win in every footprint pair.
Thus exact strengths, associations and scores discriminate models where winner
membership does not. Independent focal strength is footprint-invariant here, but
the later average over retained episode contents is not. Flat remains the already
retired negative control; a finite score equality does not rehabilitate it. Neither
the independent nor hybrid result establishes universal footprint immunity.

One continuously evolving subject has physical resources, sleep/circadian state,
damage, intoxicant burden, reward/stress/arousal regulators, exposure-keyed tolerance/
sensitization, transient satiation and acquired regulatory targets. Chosen execution
changes this body. Current and consequence interoception feed separate experienced
pleasure, withdrawal relief, restorative benefit and harm learning. Learned expectation
and cue history interact with maintained goals and physiology-sensitive inhibition;
independent reasons use the retained dice grammar to choose the next actual action.
Appraised threat can produce a named delayed stress impulse, which affects later
interoception/control. Body truth never becomes a character belief by inspection.
